title: Quiz: Aggregate Functions
description: Check your understanding of Aggregate Functions.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in SQL?
questions.explanation: In SQL, -- marks a comment. Block comments use /* */.

questions.question: What is the difference between WHERE and HAVING?
questions.correctAnswer: WHERE filters rows; HAVING filters groups

questions.question: True or False: HAVING applies after GROUP BY aggregation.
What is the main purpose of the Aggregate Functions technique shown in this lesson?
questions.explanation: It exists to help you aggregate functions effectively.

questions.question: In SQL, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
